violations.policy_section: Retail agent policy > Modify pending order > Modify items
violations.policy_clause: In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all the items they want to modify.
violations.policy_requirement: In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all the items they want to modify.
violations.description: In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all the items they want to modify.
violations.reason: The agent presented the modification details and requested explicit confirmation, but did not include the required reminder to confirm that all items to be modified had been provided. This reminder is an explicit obligation under the Modify items policy, and its omission constitutes a violation.
